title: Paged ordered index: stable duplicate-key cursors and complete pagination
statement:
# Paged ordered index (`src/`)

Repair the package that implements a paged ordered index with duplicate keys, range queries, opaque cursors, and forward/reverse pagination. Entries are ordered by `(key, insertion id)`. A cursor must round-trip as `id.key`; locating a cursor must compare the full position; page splitting uses the balanced midpoint; and a next cursor is returned only when an additional result exists. Preserve the existing `PagedIndex`, `range`, and pagination APIs.

bugs.summary: Page lookup compares only keys, not the full key-and-id position.
Cursor encoding and decoding use key.id instead of the documented id.key representation.
Page splitting moves the midpoint to avoid separating equal keys, producing an unbalanced split.
Pagination does not fetch a look-ahead item and reports a next cursor even when the page is final.
